''See also: [[pure madra Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Pure [[madra]] is the fundamental, unformed material of the soul and serves as the basis for all other types of spiritual power. It is characterized by its lack of specific [[aspects]], appearing as a colorless or blue-white energy that acts with extreme fluidity and adaptability. Because it lacks the specialized properties of elements like fire or [[water]], it is considered weak in terms of physical interaction; it cannot influence the material world or defend against physical objects like arrows. However, it is unparalleled in its ability to affect the [[spirit]] directly. It can be used to attack or defend a soul, disrupt an opponent's spiritual rhythm, and cleanse impurities from [[madra channels]]. In practical application, pure [[madra]] is highly compatible with all other forms of energy. It can be used to activate [[scripts]], nourish [[constructs]], and facilitate soulsmithing due to its universal nature. While it can strengthen a practitioner's capacity or refine their power, adding pure [[madra]] to specialized [[aspects]] is often compared to adding [[water]] to wine, as it tends to dilute the potency of specific elemental qualities. Despite these limitations, it remains a vital component for spiritual growth and the maintenance of complex magical items.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Pure [[madra]] is a rare substance that possesses many advantages and disadvantages, remaining compatible with all things despite its inherent weakness. While it is second to none for attacking and defending the [[spirit]], it lacks the ability to interact with the physical world. This energy can be utilized to repair a core or to cleanse a [[spirit]] of [[Blackflame]] corrosion. During his training, [[Lindon]] was observed [[cycling]] this unique [[madra]].}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Characterized by an almost colorless appearance with a tinge of blue-white, pure [[madra]] was found in the form of [[scales]] within [[Eithan]]'s section of a box. [[Lindon]] attempted to engage in combat using only this substance, discovering that it could be used to boost the performance of a [[construct]]. During a confrontation, [[Eithan]] released a detonation of pure [[madra]], which possesses the ability to wipe away [[fire madra]]. Additionally, [[Lindon]] utilized pure [[madra]] to direct spiritual power.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|During his encounter with [[Seishen Daji|Daji]], [[Lindon]] utilized pure [[madra]] to cleanse the energy from her armor. When a power drain occurred, this substance streamed directly into his [[spirit]]. Although pure [[madra]] is characterized by its natural subtlety, [[Lindon]] found he could project a domineering impression through it. Furthermore, his bond with [[Little Blue]] caused his pure [[madra]] to feel like a cleansing tide.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Pure [[madra]] manifests as a liquid blue-white column of power located in the center of a cave and is characterized by an emptiness. [[Lindon]] utilizes pulses of this substance to activate [[constructs]] and employs it to build his own meeting-space. This unique energy can be used to soothe chaos within a soul, a capability demonstrated by [[Little Blue]]'s ability to send soothing pulses. While the [[Wei Grand Elder]] can gather pure [[madra]] in his palm, [[Yerin]] requires either [[Shadow|shadow]] or this specific energy to combat spirits.}}
